originalTitle: Sanders proposes bill to stop Social Security benefit garnishment for unpaid student loans
summary: Sen. Bernie Sanders, I-Vt., announced a new proposal on Monday to protect federal student loan borrowers from having their Social Security checks garnished.
content:
Sen. Bernie Sanders, I-Vt., is pitching a new bill to stop seniors from having money withheld from their Social Security checks due to unpaid federal student loan debt.

Sanders announced the proposal on Monday and will formally introduce the bill — called the Stop Social Security Garnishment Act — when the Senate is back in session next month, according to a spokesperson for the senator.

The bill is also backed by Democratic Sens. Elizabeth Warren and Ed Markey, both of Massachusetts.

About 9.5 million borrowers are in default on their student loans, according to an Associated Press analysis of federal data through March.

Read more CNBC personal finance coverage

Nearly 1 in 4 borrowers cannot repay their loans and are at risk of having their wages or Social Security checks seized, according to Sanders' announcement.

Sanders' proposal comes as the Trump administration has paused involuntary collections for borrowers in default on federal student loans.

What's happening with student loan collections

The Trump administration said in June 2025 that it would not cut Social Security benefits for affected borrowers, reversing course months after it announced plans to resume collection activity following Covid-era policies that had protected borrowers who had fallen behind.

Then in January, the Education Department said it planned to delay wage garnishment and other involuntary collections while it worked to implement new federal student loan repayment options from President Donald Trump 's "big beautiful bill."

Reforms enacted through the tax law reduced the number of repayment plans overall and also launched two new repayment options starting on July 1.

For student loan borrowers in default, the delay in collections may provide time for borrowers to rehabilitate their loans through repayments and get their loans out of default, the Education Department said in January.

Asked by CNBC about the status of the garnishment pause, an Education Department spokesperson referred to the January announcement.

What Sanders' proposal may mean for older borrowers

Sanders' proposal would ensure that Social Security retirement or disability benefits are not cut to repay outstanding student loan debt.

Older adults with student loans in default would be protected from forced collection of their benefit checks, ensuring they can continue to pay for basic needs such as healthcare, medicine and food, according to the proposal.

"In the richest country in the history of the world, no senior should have their Social Security payments taken away from them to pay back student debt," Sanders said in a statement. "This is especially true when seniors throughout the country already cannot afford the skyrocketing price of healthcare, prescription drugs, groceries and housing."

Around 9.6 million student loan borrowers are ages 50 and older, with nearly $457 billion in outstanding loans, according to second-quarter data from the Education Department .
chineseTitle: 桑德斯提出法案，停止对未付学生贷款扣押社会保障福利
chineseSummary: 佛蒙特州参议员伯尼·桑德斯周一宣布了一项新提案，旨在保护联邦学生贷款借款人的社会保障支票不被扣押。
chineseContent:
佛蒙特州参议员伯尼·桑德斯正在提出一项新法案，以阻止老年人因未偿还联邦学生贷款债务而从社会保障支票中扣留资金。

桑德斯的发言人表示，桑德斯周一宣布了该提案，并将在参议院下个月重新开会时正式提出该法案，称为“停止社会保障扣押法案”。

该法案还得到了马萨诸塞州民主党参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦和埃德·马基的支持。

美联社对截至 3 月份的联邦数据进行的分析显示，约有 950 万借款人拖欠学生贷款。

阅读更多 CNBC 个人理财报道

根据桑德斯的公告，近四分之一的借款人无法偿还贷款，并面临工资或社会保障支票被没收的风险。

桑德斯提出这一提议之际，特朗普政府已暂停对拖欠联邦学生贷款的借款人进行非自愿催收。

学生贷款催收发生了什么

特朗普政府于 2025 年 6 月表示，不会削减受影响借款人的社会保障福利，几个月后，特朗普政府宣布计划恢复追收活动，遵循新冠时代保护落后借款人的政策。

然后在一月份，教育部表示计划推迟工资扣押和其他非自愿征收，同时努力实施唐纳德·特朗普总统“美丽的大法案”中的新联邦学生贷款偿还选项。

通过税法实施的改革减少了总体还款计划的数量，并从 7 月 1 日开始推出了两种新的还款选项。

教育部一月份表示，对于违约的学生贷款借款人来说，延迟催收可能会为借款人提供时间通过还款恢复贷款并摆脱违约。

当被 CNBC 询问暂停扣押的情况时，教育部发言人提到了 1 月份的公告。

桑德斯的提议对年长借款人可能意味着什么

桑德斯的提议将确保社会保障退休金或残疾福利不会因偿还未偿还的学生贷款债务而被削减。

根据该提案，拖欠学生贷款的老年人将免受强制领取福利支票的影响，确保他们能够继续支付医疗保健、药品和食品等基本需求。

桑德斯在一份声明中表示：“在世界历史上最富有的国家，任何老年人都不应该被剥夺社会保障金来偿还学生债务。” “当全国老年人已经无力承担医疗保健、处方药、杂货和住房价格飞涨的情况时，情况尤其如此。”

根据教育部第二季度的数据，大约 960 万学生贷款借款人年龄在 50 岁及以上，未偿还贷款接近 4,570 亿美元。
